title: Device event
description: A discrete state change or fault, as opposed to a periodic sample. Published at QoS 1: losing one loses information that telemetry will not repeat.

kind.description: What happened. Closed set: an unrecognised kind means the consumer is older than the device.

detail.description: Human-readable context. Never parsed; anything a consumer must act on belongs in a typed field.

metric.description: Which metric the event concerns, when it concerns one.
